$comment: Personal (non-organizational) contact details found in the research files. The importer scrubs every value listed here from all output and marks affected records privacy_hold: true. Nothing here reaches the public site until the person has been asked. Move an entry to `cleared` with a note once permission is confirmed.

held.person: Divya (co-founder, Flatbush Cats; volunteers with NYC Bird Alliance)
held.reason: Offered as a personal contact for questions in a document shared privately. A personal mobile on a public crisis page invites unbounded call volume.
held.ask: Confirm with Divya whether she wants to be listed, and if so under what hours and which number.

held.found_in: Exotic workbook row 55 Phone; 'Wildlife rehabilitation' tab line 10
held.reason: A home line plus two personal mobiles, for a rehab operation run out of a private residence. Published by NYC Bird Alliance on a public referral page, so arguably already public -- but republishing a home number is a decision for them, not us.
held.ask: Ask WINORR which number they want listed. Keep the organization record either way; it routes NYC raptor cases.

held.reason: An individual volunteer's mobile, not an organizational line.
held.ask: Confirm he is willing to be listed publicly for bird-of-prey transport.

held.reason: An individual's mobile, listed as text-only, with no organizational identity attached.
held.ask: Confirm before listing; a text-only line may not want public traffic.

name_holds.reason: The organization (Cottontail Cottage, cottontailrehab.com) and its number are public; the operator's first name adds nothing for a user in a crisis.
name_holds.action: Strip the first name, keep the organization and its number.
